t: This is the Queen Alexandra Memorial, a bronze screen set into the garden wall of Marlborough House and facing St James's Palace. It has allegorical figures and is a late example of Art Nouveau. The sculptor, Sir Alfred Gilbert, worked on it between 1926 and 1932 and regarded it as his swan song. He's also known for the Shaftesbury Memorial Fountain, Anteros, in Piccadilly Circus, made in the years when he was at his most creative.
